verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at braintrust.dev (HTTP 200) with an agent-oriented product summary. SDK reference pages are also served as markdown (.md URLs for Python, Go and Java docs), which gives agents machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: the root docs.md returns 404, there is no evidence of an llms-full.txt or of how complete the llms.txt index is, and there is no independent or hands-on report of agents actually consuming these docs.
